svg.title: Menopause: where she is in the transition (perimenopause, menopause, early menopause at 40 to 45, premature ovarian insufficiency under 40, each with its cycle and hormone cut-offs), then for hot flashes whether she can safely start menopausal hormone therapy (estrogen, plus progesterone if she has a uterus) or needs non-hormonal drugs, and for genitourinary symptoms local treatment in two steps
